implementation: Cisco Secure Services FIPS PRNG Engine
description: This is the ANSI X9.31 A.2.4 PRNG Implementation for the Cisco Secure Services Client FIPS Module. The Cisco Secure Services Client FIPS module is a self contained crypto module that supports IEEE 802.11i security (WPA2) along with secure EAP types such as EAP-TLS, EAP-FAST, and PEAP while operating in FIPS 140-2 mode.
